prompt:
I'm going to travel from May 25 to June 29.
First, I'm going to Halle (Saale), Germany.

During my travel I want to visit Italy (Florence, Rom, Pisa, Capri, Milan), Switzerland (Lugano), Netherlands (Amesterdam, Maastricht), Spain (Madrid, Barcelona), France (Paris, Lyon), Germany (Berlin, Dresden) and Prague.

From May 25-May 29 I want to stay in Halle (Saale), Dresden, Leipzig and Berlin.

I want to visit Prague for only two days, only from June 14-June 16.

After visiting Milan, I want to go Lugano straight and come back to Milan.

I also don't want to visit Venice.

I want to have three days in Paris.

I want to go to the Netherlands from either Paris or Berlin.

On June 27 I want to go back to Halle.

Help me to plan my travel.
answer:
## Suggested itinerary

**Route overview:**  
Halle → Dresden → Leipzig → Berlin → Amsterdam → Maastricht → Paris → Lyon → Barcelona → Madrid → Milan ↔ Lugano → Prague → Florence → Pisa → Rome → Capri → Naples → Berlin → Halle

### Day-by-day plan

| Date | Plan | Overnight |
|---|---|---|
| **May 25 (Mon)** | Arrive in **Halle (Saale)**. Explore the old town, Marktplatz, and Handel’s House. | Halle |
| **May 26 (Tue)** | Train Halle → **Dresden** (~2h). Visit the Zwinger, Frauenkirche, and historic centre. | Dresden |
| **May 27 (Wed)** | Train Dresden → **Leipzig** (~1h15). Visit St. Thomas Church and the old town. | Leipzig |
| **May 28 (Thu)** | Train Leipzig → **Berlin** (~1h15). Afternoon at Brandenburg Gate and central Berlin. | Berlin |
| **May 29 (Fri)** | Full day in **Berlin**: Museum Island, East Side Gallery, or Reichstag area. | Berlin |
| **May 30 (Sat)** | Berlin → **Amsterdam** by train (~6h) or flight (~1h15). | Amsterdam |
| **May 31 (Sun)** | Full day in **Amsterdam**: canals, Jordaan, museums. | Amsterdam |
| **Jun 1 (Mon)** | Amsterdam → **Maastricht** (~2h30). Explore the old town and riverfront. | Maastricht |
| **Jun 2 (Tue)** | Full day in **Maastricht**. | Maastricht |
| **Jun 3 (Wed)** | Maastricht → **Paris** (~2h20 via Liège). Afternoon in Paris. | Paris |
| **Jun 4 (Thu)** | **Paris — full day 1**. | Paris |
| **Jun 5 (Fri)** | **Paris — full day 2**. | Paris |
| **Jun 6 (Sat)** | **Paris — full day 3**. | Paris |
| **Jun 7 (Sun)** | Paris → **Lyon** (~2h). Explore Vieux Lyon. | Lyon |
| **Jun 8 (Mon)** | Full day in **Lyon**. | Lyon |
| **Jun 9 (Tue)** | Lyon → **Barcelona** by train (~5h) or flight (~1h30). | Barcelona |
| **Jun 10 (Wed)** | Full day in **Barcelona**. | Barcelona |
| **Jun 11 (Thu)** | Barcelona → **Madrid** (~2h30). Afternoon in Madrid. | Madrid |
| **Jun 12 (Fri)** | Full day in **Madrid**; late flight to **Milan** (~2h). | Milan |
| **Jun 13 (Sat)** | Morning in **Milan**; train to **Lugano** (~1h15), then return to Milan. | Milan |
| **Jun 14 (Sun)** | Morning flight Milan → **Prague** (~1h30). Afternoon in Prague. | Prague |
| **Jun 15 (Mon)** | Full day in **Prague**. | Prague |
| **Jun 16 (Tue)** | Morning in Prague; fly to Florence/Bologna and continue to **Florence**. | Florence |
| **Jun 17 (Wed)** | Full day in **Florence**. | Florence |
| **Jun 18 (Thu)** | Florence → **Pisa** in the morning; afternoon train Pisa → **Rome**. | Rome |
| **Jun 19 (Fri)** | Full day in **Rome**. | Rome |
| **Jun 20 (Sat)** | Full day in **Rome**. | Rome |
| **Jun 21 (Sun)** | Rome → Naples → ferry to **Capri**. | Capri |
| **Jun 22 (Mon)** | Full day in **Capri/Anacapri**. | Capri |
| **Jun 23 (Tue)** | Ferry Capri → **Naples**; afternoon in Naples. | Naples |
| **Jun 24 (Wed)** | Buffer/relax day in Naples; optional Pompeii or Herculaneum. | Naples |
| **Jun 25 (Thu)** | Fly Naples → **Berlin**; evening in Berlin. | Berlin |
| **Jun 26 (Fri)** | Berlin buffer day. | Berlin |
| **Jun 27 (Sat)** | Train Berlin → **Halle** (~1h20). Return to Halle as requested. | Halle |
| **Jun 28 (Sun)** | Halle buffer day. | Halle |
| **Jun 29 (Mon)** | Depart from Halle/Leipzig/Berlin. | — |

### Constraint check

- **May 25–29:** Halle, Dresden, Leipzig, and Berlin are all covered, with two nights in Berlin.
- **Prague:** exactly **June 14–16**, two nights only.
- **Milan → Lugano → Milan:** done as a same-day return trip on **June 13**, so you go straight to Lugano after Milan and return to Milan.
- **Paris:** three full days, **June 4–6**.
- **Netherlands from Berlin:** Berlin → Amsterdam on **May 30**.
- **June 27:** return to Halle by train from Berlin.
- **Venice:** not included.

### Practical notes

- The first week is fast-paced; travel light and book the Halle–Dresden–Leipzig–Berlin trains early.
- Book the **Milan → Prague**, **Prague → Florence/Bologna**, and **Naples → Berlin** flights in advance.
- Naples is included mainly as the practical gateway to Capri and for the flight back to Berlin; it does not need to be a major sightseeing stop.
- Keep the Berlin–Halle train on June 27 simple and leave a buffer in case the Naples–Berlin flight is delayed.
